message.content:
This is a CO2 absorber cartridge for anesthesia machines. Likely candidates are 9018.90 (other medical instruments and appliances), 9019.20 (ozone, oxygen, aerosol therapy, artificial respiration or other therapeutic respiration apparatus), and 9033 (parts and accessories for Chapter 90 machines).

I recall CBP rulings on Dräger CLIC absorbers that classified them in 9018.90.8000 or 9019.20. Anesthesia apparatus falls under 9018.90.75 or 9018.90.80. HTS 9018.90.75 covers "Electro-medical apparatus: other," and 9018.90.80 covers "Other" instruments and appliances. Anesthesia equipment is typically in 9018.90.80. Parts and accessories of anesthesia apparatus would be classified in 9018.90.

The absorber is a chemical-filled cartridge that works as a component of the breathing circuit. It could be seen as a part of an anesthesia apparatus, and 9018.90.8000 is the likely classification: "Other instruments and appliances... Other."

I'll go with 9018.90.8000.
